title: Daylight Lands $80 Million for AI-Powered Security Operations
description: Daylight, an Israeli-American cybersecurity startup, has raised $80 million to advance its AI-powered security operations platform called Aura. Aura uses AI automation combined with human expertise to detect, analyze, and contain cyber threats in real time, including protection for AI platforms against prompt injection and rogue AI activity. The funding will support product development, team expansion, and market growth. This announcement is a funding and product development update rather than a security vulnerability or active threat.
